name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.normal.team.TeamProfileActivity
description: When a user opens a team's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows its name, introduction, ID, and owner; it offers chat for a team the user can enter or a request to join when needed.
disableEffect: Users can no longer view team details, open its chat, or request to join through this ContactKit page.
